name: Attendance Is Paid On Home, Not Only At Start
note: D45 (emulator, 2026-10-29): attendance was claimed only when the app started, so a phone that kept the app in the background got nothing until it was killed. The gate moves the page clock past midnight and sends visibilitychange by hand — page.clock does neither hide nor show the page (Gemini G4-3).

mutations.name: coming back to the app on Home claims nothing
mutations.why: The original bug: the app in the background is never started again, so the day is never paid.
mutations.expectFailure: coming back to the front on Home pays the new day

mutations.name: reaching Home claims nothing
mutations.why: A day that turned during a game would be paid only on the next start or the next return to the front.

mutations.name: coming back to the app in a game claims there
mutations.why: The reward window would open over the board in the middle of a move.
mutations.expectFailure: coming back on a game pays nothing yet
